text: Kroger agreed to pay up to $1.4 billion to settle opioid lawsuits with states, counties and tribes in 2023.
short: Kroger agreed to pay up to $1.4 billion to settle opioid lawsuits with states, counties and tribes in 2023.

source.name: Los Angeles Times article on Kroger opioid settlement
source.quote: Kroger Co. will pay up to $1.4 billion over 11 years.

additionalSources.name: CNBC, "Kroger will pay up to $1.2 billion to settle most nationwide opioid claims"
additionalSources.quote: Kroger will pay $1.2 billion to U.S. states and local governments and $36 million to Native American tribes over 11 years.
